breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains 'wall' (noSlip) boundary conditions on the front and back patches throughout all field files (U, T, p, p_rgh, k, epsilon, nut, alphat) and also explicitly states 'Front and back patches are treated as walls to enforce 2D behavior.' The ground truth requires the front and back patches to be 'empty' type boundary conditions to properly enforce 2D in OpenFOAM. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
